symptom: a call external action argument's Associations to include had no MDL: describe did not print the tree, a new call could not have one, and — found while measuring — a `create or modify` that took the splice path rebuilt the call and dropped the stored tree, with no warning, although #1922's carry claimed to keep it
cause: #1922 wired carryIncludedAssociations into buildMicroflowFromStmt only; a create or modify of a stored flow is applied by modifyFlowInPlace first, whose replace op rebuilds the activity through the alter-flow fragment builder and never reaches the carry
file: mdl/grammar/domains/MDLMicroflow.g4 (includeAssociationsClause), mdl/executor/cmd_microflows_builder_calls.go (buildIncludedAssociations), external_action_carry.go (stated, carriedIncludes), cmd_alter_flow.go (replace carries, statedIncludes), cmd_flow_modify.go (warning), cmd_microflows_format_action.go (describe), validate_external_action_includes.go (MDL-ODATA10), validate_external_action_calls.go (check resolution); tests external_action_include_clause_test.go, external_action_include_splice_pedapp_test.go, mdl/backend/modelsdk/microflow_external_action_include_clause_test.go
insight: A carry for unauthored state has as many sites as the statement has write paths: create or modify of a STORED flow is a splice first and a rebuild only on fallback, so a carry in the rebuild alone is skipped in the common case. The mock harness never caught it because its stored flow had no start/end and always fell back to the rebuild — the bug only showed on a real project. Enumerate the write paths (rebuild, splice replace, alter replace) and test the splice against the real backend (PedApp + a local $metadata). IsParent is derived from the side entity being the association's FROM end; the authored tree encodes to Studio Pro 11.16's bytes, $IDs aside, and flipping IsParent breaks that comparison. Controls: stashing the splice change fails the PedApp test with the tree dropped; removing the stated skip makes `include associations ()` keep the tree.
